prose: Billed pcs are our commercial book only — not market size. We cannot compute % of first DPD sold in warranty: no non-warranty first-fail denominator exists.
Track A hero: commercial ~148 pcs/yr · €317,238/yr; warranty on same PN €41,493 / 15 lines (~6% of billed € on this PN). VIN-first early <30k = 20% on N=15 (directional only).
UMI+IUK hold ~73% of our Track A pcs/yr. Portugal ~5.8 pcs/yr in our book — interest gate, not 'no market'.
Fleet pcs/1,000 UIO is an unresolved-gap flag (under-service, long can life, or price-out) — not an IML interval and not capture %.
Landed-cost ASSUMPTION vs our ASP only: base headroom ~€786/unit (cleaning €660 + freight €150 RT + 25% NG). Not a market-size proof — replace with Optymha + freight COLLECT.
Track B: billed full ASM ~21 pcs/yr · €28,573; FILTER claim PNs ~€968,550 — insert R&R dwarfs full-can commercial. UK VIN assembly 11 vs filter 101.

reasons: Commercial book is real: €660,172 / 307 pcs (56% of network DPD ASM), mainly UMI + IUK — this is captured sales, not market size.

VIN-first warranty pool: 15 vehicles; 33% at ≥50k km (wear), 20% early (<30k km). N is small — directional only.
Portugal ~5.77 pcs/yr in our book — interest gate; do not conclude 'no market' from billed pcs alone. Fleet pcs/1,000 UIO stays unresolved (under-service, long life, or price-out).
Peer ladder on this PN is almost empty — collect OEM / reman / IAM before a go.
Return rate, reman unit cost, and yield % are UNKNOWN — no go without those.

Reman only clears if it sits above cleaning and below grey/new. Cleaning € is COLLECT (Optymha/Ceramex) — ASSUMPTION sensitivity is vs our ASP only, not a market-size proof. Euro 6d sandwich not yet measured.
